text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
How splendid, Trainer! Strength really is
all about
how you use it, no matter how
small!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I've learned another new lesson today!
For a princess, merely being able to
crush macadamia
nuts with her hands is
not enough!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess must also have the
delicate
precision to move tiny seeds
between plates with
chopsticks!
